_comment: Native connector coverage registry. Must equal core/conan/coverage.cpp (tests/drift_test.py). 'status' is evidence (live-supported needs MCP plus client evidence); 'implementation' says whether native code exists ('native') or the action still answers a structured not-ported error ('pending').

statusLegend.live-supported: Native code exists and was proven live through Takaro with MCP and client evidence.
statusLegend.schema-fallback: Answers the schema-valid empty DTO Takaro requires because the data does not exist for this game.
statusLegend.unsupported: Answers a structured error because neither the game nor Takaro can back it.
statusLegend.pending: Native code is missing or not yet proven live; transitional, must be gone before release.

getPlayer.responseShape: public Takaro player DTO or null
getPlayer.verification: MCP gameserverGetPlayers then the player, with the client online
getPlayer.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: PlayerArray -> PlayerState -> controller (read path proven in stage 1).

getPlayers.verification: MCP gameserverGetPlayers with the client online
getPlayers.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: PlayerArray -> PlayerState -> controller, plus ping and IP.

getPlayerLocation.responseShape: { x: number, y: number, z: number }
getPlayerLocation.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: K2_GetActorLocation through ProcessEvent.

giveItem.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: CheatSpawnItem or the in-process console executor.
